distractorExplanations.b: A long wait does not authorize crossing; call the posted railroad number and wait for the gates to rise or an officer to direct you.
distractorExplanations.c: Following another vehicle does not make it safe; with gates down you stay stopped until the gates rise and signals clear.

prompt: Passenger comfort on long grades includes managing

options.text: Speed, brakes (avoid fade), and transmission use appropriate to the vehicle
Speed, by applying the service brakes lightly and steadily all the way down
Speed, by selecting a lower gear partway down once the bus picks up speed
Speed, by coasting in neutral and using the brakes as the bus speeds up

explanation: Control speed early; brake fade endangers everyone aboard.

distractorExplanations.b: Light continuous braking overheats the brakes and causes fade; use a low gear with snub braking instead.
distractorExplanations.c: Select the low gear before starting down; trying to downshift once speed builds may leave you unable to get into gear.
distractorExplanations.d: Coasting removes engine braking and is prohibited; it makes the brakes do all the work and leads to fade.

prompt: In fog, a bus driver should

options.text: Keep to the speed limit and use the vehicle ahead's taillights as a guide
Slow down, increase following distance, and use appropriate lighting
Slow down and switch to high beams so other drivers see you sooner
Slow down and pull onto the shoulder with only parking lights on

explanation: Reduce speed to visibility; avoid clustering on leaders’ lights.

distractorExplanations.a: Following taillights gives a false sense of safety; speed must drop to what you can see, not stay at the limit.
distractorExplanations.c: High beams reflect off fog and reduce your own vision; low beams and fog lights are used.

prompt: Mirror use before lane changes on a bus is essential because

options.text: Convex mirrors show the true distance of vehicles traveling alongside the bus

Cross promptly before the warning ends so you do not wait

prompt: Excessive speeding in a passenger bus is prohibited because

options.text: Bus speed governors fail above 65 mph, cutting engine power suddenly
